We'll be walking around Old City / Queen Village for some shopping at locally-owned small businesses for Small Business Saturday!
We'll start at 11AM at Menagerie in Old City, then make our way down to Bloomsday for lunch at 1PM
After lunch, we'll head to Queen Village to continue our shop small journey :)
Here's a map of all the places we'll go to 🙂
Free for Club Members
$10 for non-members
See you then 👋
